messages:
heidi: noticed console quota heatmaps spiking for some tenants after SDK header change. looks like quota-bucket tag changed name so our console split view shows duplicate buckets.

sam: which SDK/version?

heidi: py-sdk 0.16.0-canary renamed X-RDWD-QUOTA to X-Quota-Bucket. proxies still emit old name and ingestion pipeline treats them as different labels.

nav: that will fragment per-tenant quota usage. billing pipeline dedups later, but customers see 2 small burns instead of 1 big burn. confusing in alerts.

leo: quick fixes: 1) ingestion canonicalize alias headers -> single bucket name, 2) console add "merge aliases" toggle while rollout happens, 3) SDK to emit both headers for one minor.

ci-bot: deploy infra-patch v3.2.1 -> success (1769999998) :white_check_mark:

sam: I can send a tiny py-sdk patch to emit both headers behind env var QUOTA_SHIM=enabled. will also add note to changelog.

heidi: I'll add console flag and a tooltip explaining this is temporary during header migration. schedule ops check in 30m.

nav: long-term we should add a header-negotiation handshake between client and proxy so renames don't break metrics. filing ticket.

leo: TL;DR: root cause = header rename without proxy/ingestion handshake -> split metrics; short-term = shim + ingestion canonicalization + console toggle; owners: sam(sdk), heidi(console), nav(ingest).

heidi: thanks, closing when heatmaps stabilize.
